name: Roman Electric
label: Featured Case Study
overview: Roman Electric was an established service business with room to expand its non-brand search footprint. The SEO strategy focused on technical refinement, stronger service-page architecture and broader topical coverage.
scope: Reorganized the service architecture into clear Electrical, Plumbing and HVAC silos to strengthen topical relevance.
Addressed Core Web Vitals and mobile-usability issues across priority service pages.
Implemented local-business schema, refined page targeting and aligned service content with local and near-me intent.
Expanded visibility beyond existing branded demand into a broader set of service and discovery queries.
interpretation: The strongest signal was reach: impressions more than doubled while total clicks still increased. The softer blended position and CTR are best read in the context of a much wider query footprint, where many newly visible searches initially appeared deeper in the SERPs.

name: Milwaukee Signarama
label: Featured Case Study
overview: The objective was to expand organic reach beyond core branded demand in a competitive local signage market. Through localized content expansion, stronger internal linking and commercially aligned on-page SEO, the site increased both impressions and clicks.
scope: Developed geo-targeted and service-specific content to capture broader local demand.
Streamlined internal linking so relevance and link equity flowed toward priority service pages.
Reworked metadata and page-level optimization around local user intent and commercially relevant signage queries.
Expanded the search footprint across a broader set of industry and discovery searches.
interpretation: Impressions nearly doubled while clicks increased by more than 83%. The small shift in blended average position is consistent with a site entering additional queries at deeper positions before those rankings mature.

name: P2EzPay
label: Featured Case Study
overview: P2EzPay entered the engagement with limited organic traction in the competitive payment-solutions space. The work prioritized technical cleanup, clearer intent targeting and content clusters around payment security and global transactions.
scope: Audited crawl efficiency, schema-markup errors and foundational issues that could limit search-engine understanding.
Reworked core landing pages, H1-H3 structures and metadata around high-intent commercial themes.
Built a cluster-led content framework around Payment Security, Global Transactions and supporting topics.
Expanded the searchable footprint while clicks, impressions and average position improved together.
interpretation: Because the project started from a small base, percentage growth should be read alongside absolute numbers. Even with that context, clicks, impressions and average position all moved in the right direction during the same 120-day period.

name: Two Guys Home Furnishing Dubai
label: Growth Case Study
overview: During the tracked Search Console comparison, total organic clicks increased from 993 to 1.91K while impressions expanded from 76.9K to 218K. Average position improved slightly from 45 to 44.
scope: Expanded search visibility across commercially relevant furnishing, flooring, blinds and curtain themes.
Improved traffic acquisition as a broader search footprint translated into more organic visits.
Evaluated CTR and average position in the context of much wider query coverage.
interpretation: The core outcome was a substantially larger search footprint that also generated more traffic. Ranking positions are historical captures from the project period and may vary by date, location and device.

name: Blinds and Curtains Dubai
label: Migration Case Study
milestone: WordPress to custom platform migration in Jan 2025
overview: The project included a January 2025 migration from WordPress to a custom-built platform. SEO priorities centered on redirect mapping, URL preservation, crawlability, high-intent category structure and post-launch monitoring.
scope: Managed the SEO transition with detailed 301 redirect mapping and URL-continuity planning.
Monitored crawlability, indexation and ranking behaviour after launch so migration issues could be identified quickly.
Reorganized product and service hierarchy while protecting high-intent categories with existing search value.
Prioritized speed, Core Web Vitals and UX for image-heavy product galleries.
interpretation: The Search Console snapshot shows that substantial organic visibility was retained through a major platform change. Query-level rankings provide important context for the site-wide average position.

name: Khanabadosh Glamps
label: Build + SEO Case Study
overview: Khanabadosh Glamps was a combined website-development and SEO engagement. Search visibility was considered from the foundation rather than added only after launch, with destination-led targeting around Murree and Kumrat.
scope: Developed the website with SEO considerations integrated into site structure and content from the beginning.
Aligned search strategy with the way travellers search for glamping and resort options in Murree and Kumrat.
Structured and optimized priority pages around glamping, resort, pod and destination themes.
Built architecture connecting the brand, accommodation offering and destination relevance.
interpretation: The combined build-and-SEO approach produced visibility beyond branded searches, including #4 for khanabadosh pods and page-one positions for destination-led glamping terms.
